notes.summary: The architectural competition and district-history descriptions locate the former market depot at Hídépítő and Helyi kikötő streets. District history identifies their later names as Dalai láma and Ujgur mártírok. Only these named road anchors are source-backed; other manual trace links are analyst estimates.

Local association history describes the holiday estate and its private ownership/parcellation history; association notices identify Magas út and the estate network. The manual map envelope encloses the visible small-path settlement and is not the youth-camp property or the entire Csillebérc parent.

2015 district history warns about historical shifted map labels. A more precise 2013 district-history street loop lies west of Hősök fasora and differs from the archived OSM name point east of that road. The 1990 municipal naming proposal also places Nagyicce west of Hősök. Street-supported historical extent takes precedence over forcing point containment.
